LQTestCJKSubset-Bold.ttf — a 12 KB subset of Noto Sans SC (variable font instanced at weight 700), SIL Open Font
License 1.1 (see OFL.txt; Copyright 2014-2021 Adobe, Reserved Font Name 'Source', not used here). Renamed to
"LQ Test CJK Subset" because it is a modified version. Used ONLY by tests/e2e/product-check.e2e.mjs so the Chinese line of
the synthetic label renders identically on CI (no system CJK font needed) and on dev machines.
Glyphs: 国药准字感冒灵颗粒药品注册编号 H 0-9.
Source: https://github.com/google/fonts/raw/main/ofl/notosanssc/NotoSansSC%5Bwght%5D.ttf (downloaded 2026-11-09,
sha256 a3041811a78c361b1de50f953c805e0244951c21c5bd412f7232ef0d899af0da), subset with fontTools 4.60.2
(varLib.instancer wght=700, then subset.Subsetter). Subset sha256 377af1361555d606ef9da1ca701a38db27549b2b2a2ca2caa9fc1f4ddb7aa496.
